mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS totCnt FROM OCUOC_BZWKA_M T1

SELECT X.num AS idx , X.APPC_ID AS appcId , X.WKFLOW_NM AS wkflowNm , X.WKFLOW_ID AS wkflowId , X.WKFLOW_DESC AS wkflowDesc , X.BZWK_CD AS bzWkCd , X.BZWK_NM AS bzwkNm , X.APCT_DPRM_CD AS apctDprmCd , X.BR_NM AS brNm , X.PRGS_ST_CD AS prgsStCd , X.PRGS_ST_NM AS prgsStNm , X.RGSR_ID AS regId , X.REG_NM AS regNm , X.REG_DT AS regDt , X.EDTR_ID AS modId , X.MOD_NM AS modNm , X.MOD_DT AS modDt FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS num , T1.APPC_ID , T1.WKFLOW_NM , T1.WKFLOW_ID , T1.WKFLOW_DESC , T1.BZWK_CD , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM OCUOC_CCDTL_L WHERE CD_GROUP = 'BZWK_CD' AND CD_VAL = T1.BZWK_CD) AS BZWK_NM , T1.APCT_DPRM_CD , ( SELECT BR_NM FROM OCUOC_DPRMI_M WHERE BR_CD = T1.APCT_DPRM_CD) AS BR_NM , T1.PRGS_ST_CD , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM OCUOC_CCDTL_L WHERE CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND CD_VAL = T1.PRGS_ST_CD) AS PRGS_ST_NM , T1.RGSR_ID , ( SELECT EMP_KOR_FLNM FROM OCUOC_USERI_M WHERE EMPNO = T1.RGSR_ID) AS REG_NM , TO_CHAR(T1.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS') AS REG_DT , T1.EDTR_ID , ( SELECT EMP_KOR_FLNM FROM OCUOC_USERI_M WHERE EMPNO = T1.EDTR_ID) AS MOD_NM , TO_CHAR(T1.CHNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS') AS MOD_DT FROM OCUOC_BZWKA_M T1
ORDER BY T1.APPC_ID DESC ) X WHERE 1=1 AND X.num > #{stPos} AND X.num <= #{endPos}

SELECT T1.APPC_ID , T1.WKFLOW_ID , T1.WKFLOW_NM , T2.WKFLOW_ID AS T2_WKFLOW_ID , T2.WKFLOW_NM AS T2_WKFLOW_NM FROM OCUOC_BZWKA_M T1, OCUOC_BZWKF_L T2 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.APPC_ID = T2.APPC_ID AND T1.PRGS_ST_CD = 'DPLY_DONE'
AND T1.WKFLOW_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT T1.APPC_ID , T1.WKFLOW_NM , T1.WKFLOW_ID , T1.WKFLOW_DESC , T1.BZWK_CD , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM OCUOC_CCDTL_L WHERE CD_GROUP = 'BZWK_CD' AND CD_VAL = T1.BZWK_CD) AS BZWK_NM , T1.APCT_DPRM_CD , ( SELECT BR_NM FROM OCUOC_DPRMI_M WHERE BR_CD = T1.APCT_DPRM_CD) AS BR_NM , T1.PRGS_ST_CD , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM OCUOC_CCDTL_L WHERE CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND CD_VAL = T1.PRGS_ST_CD) AS PRGS_ST_NM , T1.RGSR_ID , ( SELECT EMP_KOR_FLNM FROM OCUOC_USERI_M WHERE EMPNO = T1.RGSR_ID) AS REG_NM , TO_CHAR(T1.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS') AS REG_DT , T1.EDTR_ID , ( SELECT EMP_KOR_FLNM FROM OCUOC_USERI_M WHERE EMPNO = T1.EDTR_ID) AS MOD_NM , TO_CHAR(T1.CHNG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS') AS CHNG_DT , T2.WKFLOW_ID AS T2_WKFLOW_ID , T2.WKFLOW_NM AS T2_WKFLOW_NM , T3.RULE_ID , T3.RULE_NM , T3.RULE_CD , T4.WKFLOW_ID AS T4_WKFLOW_ID , T4.WKFLOW_NM AS T4_WKFLOW_NM , T4.CMPR_FIELD , T5.FILE_NM , T5.ORG_FILE_NM , T5.FILE_PATH , T5.FILE_EXT , T6.SCN_NO FROM OCUOC_BZWKA_M T1 INNER JOIN OCUOC_BZWKF_L T2 ON T1.APPC_ID = T2.APPC_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_BZAFF_L T3 ON T1.APPC_ID = T3.APPC_ID AND T3.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_BZAFR_L T4 ON T3.RULE_ID = T4.RULE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_BZAAF_L T5 ON T1.APPC_ID = T5.APPC_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OCUOC_BZSCN_L T6 ON T1.APPC_ID = T6.APPC_ID AND T6.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND T1.APPC_ID = #{appcId}
